title: 总体架构
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a professional Chinese software architecture review graphic for loom-oi alpha v0.6. White background, navy typography, blue control lines, teal data/positive paths, amber warnings, refined flat vector-like editorial diagram. Landscape 16:10 except the sequence chart may be portrait 4:5 for legibility. Large crisp Simplified Chinese, generous spacing, no 3D, mascots, marketing claims, invented metrics or components. Header "loom-oi · alpha v0.6", subtitle "推荐设计 · 待实现验证". Exact semantic accuracy is more important than decoration. Every arrow must have correct endpoints and direction, and must avoid crossing labels. Do not claim the product is implemented or adopted. Title "总体架构与责任边界". Three zones horizontally: "消费侧", "OIS · Go / 可信管理与中继", "受控环境".
Left: top "原生客户端 / 应用 / Agent" leads down to "oi CLI / 客户端库"; an optional dashed card "条件扩展：协议适配" points to CLI.
Center: top "身份 · 目录 · 策略"; bottom "授权配对 · 有界中继". A blue arrow connects management to relay labelled "授权配对". Below put an UNCONNECTED informational panel: "PostgreSQL：身份映射 / 配置 / 策略" and "连接留内存；不保存业务载荷". It is a note, not a traffic node.
Right: upper "OIC · Go" caption "登记 / 本地目标校验 / 有界转发", below "独立能力服务", caption "HTTP / 桌面 / 文件 / 设备". Teal two-way OIC↔service labeled "原生协议". Small optional probe beside service, "可选探针", blue arrow probe→service "无副作用检查" and blue arrow probe→OIC "观测结果".
INTERZONE: blue CLI→management "HTTPS 发现 / Open". Blue OIC→management "WSS 控制 · OIC主动出站", arrowhead points LEFT. TEAL two-way CLI↔relay "WSS 数据腿". TEAL two-way relay↔OIC "WSS 数据腿", use elbow UP into OIC. NEVER connect relay to service directly. Both data legs terminate at same OIS relay.
Footer three cells: "online ≠ ready"; "新通道重新鉴权；旧业务不重放"; "单活闭环 → 主备恢复验证". Small note "业务身份、状态与资源互斥由提供方负责". Legend blue control/observation; teal business data; dashed conditional extensions.
edit: Edit only connector accuracy in this architecture graphic, keep all text, colors, layout and components. The BLUE vertical line labeled 授权配对 between 身份·目录·策略 and 授权配对·有界中继 must be ONE WAY downward from management into relay: remove only the arrowhead pointing UP into management, keep downward arrowhead. Ensure the TEAL horizontal WSS 数据腿 between oi CLI/客户端库 and the central relay is clearly bidirectional with an arrowhead physically touching each card edge. Keep the teal relay↔OIC elbow and OIC↔service as is. No other changes.

title: 授权建连

Every arrow must have correct endpoints and direction, and must avoid crossing labels. Do not claim the product is implemented or adopted. Title "发现、授权与双数据腿建连". Create a precise sequence chart with FOUR vertical lifelines, left to right: "消费者 / oi", "活动 OIS", "OIC", "能力服务". Follow these chronological rows EXACTLY, no reversed arrows. Group by light background bands labeled "发现与授权", "准备与附着", "提交与转发".
Row 1: OIC → 活动OIS: "mTLS 接入、登记、generation".
Row 2: 消费者/oi → 活动OIS: "发现 Exposure / Open".
Row 3: 活动OIS self-loop: "当前策略、任期、额度".
Row 4: 活动OIS → OIC: "PrepareChannel".
Row 5: OIC self-loop: "本地目标、版本、准入、预算".
Row 6: OIC → 能力服务: "拨号固定目标"; below it service → OIC: "连接建立".
Row 7: OIC → 活动OIS: "Provider 数据腿附着".
Row 8: 活动OIS → 消费者/oi: "Consumer 附着票据".
Row 9: 消费者/oi → 活动OIS: "Consumer 数据腿附着".
Row 10: 活动OIS self-loop: "提交前复核策略版本、任期、期限".
Row 11: 活动OIS → OIC: "ChannelReady".
Row 12: 活动OIS → 消费者/oi: "ChannelReady".
Row 13: Three separate TWO-WAY TEAL arrows in a single row: consumer↔OIS, OIS↔OIC, OIC↔service. Label "原生业务字节 / 有界转发".

Two panels showing TWO ORTHOGONAL STATE DIMENSIONS, not one combined online status.
LEFT small panel "执行状态": Idle ↔ Running. Arrow Idle→Running labelled "支持且预算允许". Arrow Running→Idle labelled "完成或超时". No arrow from Running to Ready. Below "每目标最多一个在途探针".

Ready→NotReady "较新有效负面证据";
NotReady→Ready "较新有效正面证据";
Ready→Unknown "到期 / 目标版本变化";
NotReady→Unknown "到期 / 目标版本变化".

"require_ready（可配置）" / "OIC最终检查有效Ready；否则拒绝"

title: 故障恢复
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a professional Chinese software architecture review graphic for loom-oi alpha v0.6. White background, navy typography, blue control lines, teal data/positive paths, amber warnings, refined flat vector-like editorial diagram. Landscape 16:10 except the sequence chart may be portrait 4:5 for legibility. Large crisp Simplified Chinese, generous spacing, no 3D, mascots, marketing claims, invented metrics or components. Header "loom-oi · alpha v0.6", subtitle "推荐设计 · 待实现验证". Exact semantic accuracy is more important than decoration. Every arrow must have correct endpoints and direction, and must avoid crossing labels. Do not claim the product is implemented or adopted. Title "故障后恢复新通道". Use a carefully numbered five-stage recovery diagram with SWIMLANES for three responsible entities: "原活动 OIS", "数据库 / 备用 OIS", "OIC / 消费者". Do not draw more entities.
Stage 01 "旧权威失效": old OIS fails or cannot renew; side note "停止新授权与续权；许可到期停止转发". Existing channels break or close within permission lifetime.
Stage 02 "取得新任期": standby uses a database transaction ONLY AFTER lease expires or controlled handoff; text "递增 epoch，持久确认活动权威". Arrow from stage01 to stage02 is conditional, label "租约失效 / 受控移交", never imply immediate takeover.
Stage 03 "重建接入": OIC reconnects and reauthenticates through active entry; new active OIS grants "新 epoch + generation". OIC text "停用旧代数；观测回到 Unknown".
Stage 04 "重新授权": consumer discovers and opens NEW channel; OIC checks target revision and admission again. Text "重新发现 / Open / 目标与准入校验".
Stage 05 "新通道可用": pair fresh data legs; text "业务查询 / 安全重试由原协议决定". No automatic resend of old payload.
Show stage order using clear downward arrows, with each stage spanning relevant lanes, not a misleading network topology.
At bottom an amber boundary panel:
"已发生的副作用不回滚；存量连接不迁移"
"数据库权威、时钟与分区、旧实例复活均须 P3 验证"
"本图是恢复机制建议，不是已通过的 HA 承诺"
Do not imply a DB lock by itself fences network side effects; do not invent RTO/RPO.
edit:
Redesign this recovery graphic to eliminate misleading network arrow ownership. Keep the professional white/navy/blue/teal/amber style and Chinese typography, but REMOVE ALL SWIMLANES AND ALL NETWORK ARROWS. Replace with a clean top-down FIVE-STEP FLOWCHART. This is process order, not a network sequence chart. Header "loom-oi · alpha v0.6", title "故障后恢复新通道", subtitle "推荐设计 · 待实现验证". Use large numbered cards, each with exact readable text:
01 "旧权威失效"
"原活动OIS停止新授权与续权；许可到期停止转发"
"存量通道中断或在许可期限内关闭"
Arrow downward labeled "租约失效或受控移交后".
02 "备用OIS取得新任期"
"数据库事务递增epoch，持久确认新的活动权威"
Arrow down.
03 "OIC重认证与登记"
"OIC主动连接新活动入口；OIS授予新epoch与generation"
"OIC停用旧代数；观测回到Unknown"
Arrow down.
04 "消费者申请新通道"
"消费者重新发现并Open；OIS检查授权"
"OIC再次核对目标版本、准入与本地约束"
Arrow down.
05 "配对新数据腿"
"重新完成通道准备；旧业务载荷不自动重放"
"业务查询与安全重试由原生消费者/提供方协议决定"
At bottom amber panel:
"已发生副作用不回滚；存量连接不迁移"
"数据库权威、时钟、分区与旧实例复活须经P3验证"
"箭头仅表示恢复流程先后，不表示网络报文方向"
No database lock alone fences networking; no guaranteed HA/RTO/RPO; no actor sends business requests on behalf of others. Keep all text precise and avoid extra words.
edit2: Edit only the bottom amber disclaimer panel of this recovery chart. Keep exactly its first THREE bullet lines, unchanged: 已发生副作用不回滚；存量连接不迁移 / 数据库权威、时钟、分区与旧实例复活须经P3验证 / 箭头仅表示恢复流程先后，不表示网络报文方向. REMOVE the last two extra bullet lines beginning 没有数据库锁 and 任何角色. They were not requested and may be overinterpreted. Resize only the amber panel as needed. Preserve the entire header, all five numbered cards, all their exact text, arrows and style without any other change.
